g.text: Adaptation improves sea-urchin material agreement, with topology and retention costs
Exploratory, seed 42. Sea regions 1–2 TRAIN, 3 CAL, 4 EVAL; the panel was previously viewed.
All sea arms use the same uncertain-label mask. Original-six retention uses 32 DEV tiles per species.
The reference is an uncurated-library comparator, not independent truth. Panels A–C have different endpoints.
